    • Deprecated Classes
      Class
      Description
      org.openqa.selenium.bidi.browser.ClientWindow
      Not used. In BiDi spec, type `browser.ClientWindow` is just text (String).
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.ErrorCodes
      The JSON Wire Protocol is no longer used; use ErrorCodec for mapping between W3C states and exceptions. Removal is tracked by #17638 and is gated on providing a replacement extensibility seam for downstream consumers.
    • Deprecated Fields
      Field
      Description
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.CLEAR_LOCAL_STORAGE
      localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.localStorage.clear()") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.CLEAR_SESSION_STORAGE
      sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.sessionStorage.clear()") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_DOWNLOADED_FILE
      use DriverCommand.DOWNLOAD_FILE instead
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM
      localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.localStorage.getItem('key')") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_LOCAL_STORAGE_KEYS
      localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return Object.keys(window.localStorage)") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_LOCAL_STORAGE_SIZE
      localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.localStorage.length") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_SESSION_STORAGE_ITEM
      sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.sessionStorage.getItem('key')") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS
      sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return Object.keys(window.sessionStorage)") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_SESSION_STORAGE_SIZE
      sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.sessionStorage.length") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.REMOVE_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM
      localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.localStorage.removeItem('key')") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.REMOVE_SESSION_STORAGE_ITEM
      sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.sessionStorage.removeItem('key')") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.SET_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM
      localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.localStorage.setItem('key', 'value')") instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.SET_SESSION_STORAGE_ITEM
      sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.sessionStorage.setItem('key', 'value')") instead.
    • Deprecated Methods
      Method
      Description
      org.openqa.selenium.bidi.HasBiDi.getBiDi()
      BiDi is an internal implementation detail. Direct access to the BiDi object from drivers will be removed in a future release.
      org.openqa.selenium.bidi.HasBiDi.maybeGetBiDi()
      BiDi is an internal implementation detail. Direct access to the BiDi object from drivers will be removed in a future release.
      org.openqa.selenium.devtools.CdpEndpointFinder.getHttpClient(HttpClient.Factory, URI)
      Use CdpEndpointFinder.getHttpClient(HttpClient.Factory, URI, ClientConfig) instead
      org.openqa.selenium.devtools.Command.doesNotSendResponse()
      Not needed. All CDP commands return something, at least empty map.
      org.openqa.selenium.devtools.SeleniumCdpConnection.create(Capabilities)
      use SeleniumCdpConnection.create(Capabilities, ClientConfig) instead
      org.openqa.selenium.devtools.SeleniumCdpConnection.create(HttpClient.Factory, Capabilities)
      org.openqa.selenium.devtools.SeleniumCdpConnection.create(WebDriver)
      use SeleniumCdpConnection.create(WebDriver, ClientConfig) instead
      org.openqa.selenium.docker.ContainerLogs.getLogLines()
      List of container logs might be very long. If you need to write down the logs, use ContainerLogs.getLogs() to avoid reading the whole content to memory.
      org.openqa.selenium.HasDownloads.getDownloadableFiles()
      Use method HasDownloads.getDownloadedFiles() instead
      org.openqa.selenium.io.Read.resourceAsString(String)
      Use Read.resourceAsString(Class, String) instead
      org.openqa.selenium.json.JsonInput.nextInstant()
      Instant is not a basic JSON type, use the InstantCoercer instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.Proxy.getFtpProxy()
      getFtpProxy is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
      org.openqa.selenium.Proxy.setFtpProxy(String)
      setFtpProxy is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.http.Contents.string(File)
      Not needed anymore. It's a bad idea to read the entire file to memory. It may cause OutOfMemory errors in case of large files.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.http.Contents.string(Contents.Supplier, Charset)
      Use method Contents.Supplier.contentAsString(Charset) instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.http.Contents.string(HttpMessage<?>)
      Use method HttpMessage.contentAsString() instead
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.http.HttpClient.sendAsyncNative(HttpRequest, HttpResponse.BodyHandler<T>)
      use JdkHttpClient#httpClient() instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.http.HttpClient.sendNative(HttpRequest, HttpResponse.BodyHandler<T>)
      use JdkHttpClient#httpClient() instead.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.RemoteWebDriver.getDownloadableFiles()
      Use method RemoteWebDriver.getDownloadedFiles() instead
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.RemoteWebDriver.maybeGetBiDi()
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.Response.getStatus()
      The integer status is a JSON Wire Protocol artifact; use Response.getState() (the W3C state) instead. Removal is tracked by #17638.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.Response.setStatus(Integer)
      The integer status is a JSON Wire Protocol artifact; use Response.setState(String) (the W3C state) instead. Removal is tracked by #17638.
      org.openqa.selenium.remote.WebDriverInfo.createDriver(Capabilities)
      use WebDriverInfo.createDriver(Capabilities, ClientConfig) instead

      org.openqa.selenium.Keys.FN
      The FN key is not part of the W3C WebDriver specification and does not have a standardized Unicode mapping. Its behavior is not guaranteed across drivers/platforms.
